body: I've got the same issue. If I replace 'UTC', 'UTC' everywhere in Symfony\Component\Form\Extension\Core\Type\DateType back to $options['model_timezone'], $options['view_timezone'], the bug goes away.

IMO The problem is in

```
        'UTC',
        'UTC',
```

Which should instead be `date_default_timezone_get()`,`date_default_timezone_get()`

Can anybody test?

Indeed, this solves this issue:

``` php
if ('single_text' === $options['widget']) {
    $builder->addViewTransformer(new DateTimeToLocalizedStringTransformer(
        date_default_timezone_get(),
        date_default_timezone_get(),
        $dateFormat,
        $timeFormat,
        $calendar,
        $pattern
    ));
}
```

Works great now! You can now make a PR for this! :+1:
@mvrhov I think another 'UTC' params should be replaced by `date_default_timezone_get()` in `DateType` code...

issue.title: DateType and timezone
issue.body:
I have an issue with the timezone on DateType. I have the following:

``` php
$builder->add('date', 'date', array(
    'required'              => true,
    'label'                    => 'form.event.date',
    'widget'                 => 'single_text',
    'model_timezone' => 'Australia/Brisbane',
));
```

When I submit the form, it always comes through as +00:00

```
DateTime Object ( [date] => 2015-01-01 10:00:00.000000 [timezone_type] => 1 [timezone] => +00:00 )
```

Shouldn't the DateTime object be created with the model_timezone above?

body: @ferdynator indeed, should be null parameter instead of date_default_timezone_get().
